how: Fitted on the experiments the engine is tuned on (benchmarks/engines.json). Variation: each input's log standard deviation between calibrations of the same experiment (kept runs from protocol v5 on and calibration-only trials, under the latest kept run's conditions), pooled over experiments, and one common correlation between inputs. Model error: measured over predicted knee in the counted kept runs as an error each experiment's runs share and one each run has, both lognormal with a median of 1, by maximum likelihood after each run's calibration spread (its sensitivity to each input times that input's variation); a run of an experiment the fit has not seen takes both. The knees and inputs are today's harness and engine on each run's calibration (the development checks), so the model error is in-sample: fitted on runs the model was tuned on.

folds.inSample: fitted on every run, then checked on each
folds.leaveRunOut: each run checked with a fit that left out its calibration and its error
folds.leaveExperimentOut: each run checked with a fit that left out every calibration and error of its experiment
